Test fixtures only; not installed as user references or added to inventory.

- `erlenmeyer.jpg`: Nuno Nogueira (Nmnogueira), unchanged photograph, CC BY-SA 2.5.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Erlenmeyer_flask.jpg
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/
- `beaker.jpg`: Jeffrey M. Vinocur, unchanged photograph, CC BY 2.5.
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Laboratory_beaker.jpg
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.5/
- `voice-command-16k.wav`: synthetic Spanish speech generated locally with eSpeak NG 1.51,
  saying “Nexus, abrí inventario y buscá ácido nítrico”, with leading/trailing silence.
  This checks the real acoustic decoder and action integration, not human accent/noise accuracy.
- `nexus-qr.png`: generated test QR containing the literal `NEXUS-X-0001`.

The photographs were not used to train or generate the text prototypes.
